authenticate.title: Connect your Anghami account
authenticate.description: The button below opens a browser window where you sign in to Anghami and allow Music Assistant to use your account. Come back here once you are done.

abort.missing_credentials: This Music Assistant build can not connect to Anghami. Please report this to the Music Assistant team.
abort.login_failed: Could not link your Anghami account. Please start the setup again.
abort.anghami_unreachable: Could not reach Anghami. Please check your internet connection and start the setup again.
abort.playback_not_allowed: Music Assistant needs permission to play music from your Anghami account. Please start the setup again and allow playback when Anghami asks.
abort.account_already_configured: This Anghami account is already used by another Anghami provider in Music Assistant. Each account can only be added once. Sign in with a different account, or remove the other Anghami provider first.

manifest.description: Stream music from Anghami with your own Anghami account.
